text:
love me ocupa the seso and the sentidos:
absorto estoy in éxtasi amoroso,
no me concede tregua ni reposo
esta war civil of the nacidos.


Explayose the raudal of my gemidos
por the great distrito, and doloroso
of the heart, in his penar dichoso,
and my memorias anegó in olvidos;


all soy ruinas, all soy destrozos,
escándalo funesto a the amantes,
that fabrican of lástima his gozos.


the that han of to be and the that fueron antes,
estudien his salud in my sollozos,
and envidien my pain, if are constantes.

translation.title: love me ocupa the seso and the sentidos
